name: r_oomfix
_note: Review 2: the two fixes for the OOM killer picking the agent, on the t12 cell of r_cutout (700 MB test under memory.max 768M). oom_adj: tool shells raise their own oom_score_adj. cgroup: tool shells move to a child cgroup with memory.max 448M (768M minus about 300M for the agent).
